details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: normalize_path (lines 240-247); lines 155-170 deleted (is_sensitive_target_path + MAX_TARGET_PATHS/MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES); emit_context loop at line 568 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and path-count/size bounds were removed.
  WHY: Untrusted paths can inline credential-bearing files into model prompts and drive unbounded filesystem, subprocess, and prompt work.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url at lines 3038-3055; _resolve_origin_url at lines 3074-3087; _git_subprocess_env at 2987-2992 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Command-scoped git authentication was replaced with token-embedded HTTPS URLs while the compatibility-shim documentation still describes credential-free URLs.
  WHY: Tokens can appear in `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, persisted `.git/config`, git diagnostics, and logs.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: `_memory_git` removed (was lines 597-609); `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` at 594-604 now embeds `GH_TOKEN` into the URL via `printf 'https://x-access-token:%s@%s/%s\n'` | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Memory git operations embed credentials in URLs and `memory_ensure_branch` falls back to bare git operations after the authentication helper was removed.
  WHY: Tokens leak through arguments and logs, while runners without ambient credentials silently fail to update ai-memory.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 664 (`--sandbox danger-full-access`); lines 48-55 and 210-215 (broker bootstrap removed) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase changed from brokered read-only execution to full-access execution with ambient credentials.
  WHY: Untrusted failure-log content can direct workspace or git mutations and exfiltrate the real OpenRouter credential.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 140-477 removed (the entire `model_provider_broker_*` family) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model provider broker helper family was deleted while numerous live callers and tests still invoke it.
  WHY: Model-facing phases hit `command not found` and abort; any bypass would remove the credential-isolation boundary.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 493-509 (`git_with_github_auth` removed); lines 972-1352 (the entire `review_blocked_*` family removed) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Shared git-auth and review-blocked approval/successor helpers were deleted while active callers remain.
  WHY: Judge-fix and baseline pushes fail, and terminal review-blocked decisions lose or cannot execute their trusted human-approval flow.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: `gh_pr_with_all_comments` comment hydration changed to drop id, author_id, author_type, author_association (lines 766-772, 833-839, 913-924, 947-952) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The shared comment schema and identity-based ordering were reduced from `{id, author, author_id, author_type, author_association, body, created_at}` to `{author, body, created_at}`.
  WHY: Consumers cannot perform producer-ID authentication, comment-id resolution, deduplication, or stable identity-based ordering.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: `--provider-base-url` option removed at lines 95-100, 105-110, 143-148, 258-264; `base_url` hardcoded at line 261 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The configurable `--provider-base-url` option was removed while active callers still pass it.
  WHY: Config generation exits with an unknown-argument error and wedges broker-directed security-pass or other codex phases.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 62-99 (`codex_config_assemble` case statement) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: `codex_config_assemble` also stopped accepting `--provider-base-url`.
  WHY: Broker base-URL configuration is rejected before the writer runs.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: imports of MAX_TARGET_PATHS (former line 30) and is_sensitive_target_path (former line 37) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests import symbols deleted from `scripts/targeted_file_context.py`.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises `ImportError`, preventing the module and its regression coverage from running.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_signal_child_group` at lines 404-407; `_forward_signal` at lines 413-419; `_kill_child_group_if_running` lines 434-444 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: When the sudo wrapper exits while nobody-owned editor processes remain, signal paths return without issuing the privileged group signal.
  WHY: Survivors are detected or missed but not killed, leaving runaway editor processes and causing fail-closed workspace cleanup.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context at lines 539-713 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The rewrite removed OSError handling around filesystem reads and stopped skipping non-string path entries.
  WHY: TOCTOU or malformed inputs can crash prompt assembly instead of being skipped.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 59-68 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Artifact cleanup changed from committed-content and staged/worktree restoration to an index-based check and worktree-only restore, removing the cached-removal fallback.
  WHY: Staged artifact deletions or modifications can survive into implementation commits, while staged-but-untracked artifacts can abort the commit.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 380-390 (_verify_isolated_group_stopped function) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Isolated-group verification waits only two seconds before returning failure.
  WHY: Slow-to-terminate processes can produce false survivor failures and leave cleanup blocked.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: terminate_editor_attempt_process_group() at lines 289-336 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The watchdog unconditionally sleeps five seconds between TERM and the next group check.
  WHY: Every watchdog kill incurs fixed latency even when TERM already emptied the group.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `emit_context` budget tracking — `used_bytes += len(raw)` on line ~682 only counts raw file bytes | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The byte budget excludes rendered headers, footers, markers, and summaries.
  WHY: Rendered context can exceed `max_bytes` and the Codex stdin cap.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_isolated_group_has_members` at lines 348-360 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Any pgrep status other than 0 or 1 is treated as evidence that members exist.
  WHY: Transient pgrep failures can falsely block cleanup during load or procfs errors.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: `cleanup_editor_isolation` at lines 263-277 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Process-group metadata is cleared before ownership restoration succeeds.
  WHY: A transient chown failure followed by retry can restore ownership without rechecking process-group state.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_write_process_group_metadata` at lines 272-296 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Atomic `O_EXCL` metadata creation fails if a prior guard left the same process-group file.
  WHY: A resumed editor attempt can lose stall protection during initialization.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 489-491 (`if signal_failure: wrapper_returncode = 126; break`) feeding line 569 (`returncode = child.wait() if wrapper_returncode is None else None`) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: A signal-failure break can leave the child unreaped and stop output streaming without an explicit truncation indication.
  WHY: The caller cannot distinguish truncated guard output from a short editor result.
- README.md / agents.md: README.md line 1556 and agents.md line 891 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Documentation still claims all model-facing phases use an ephemeral broker token and read-only isolation.
  WHY: The documented security boundary no longer matches the deleted broker and full-access diagnose implementation.
- README.md: README.md:1556 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Operator documentation still describes the deleted model provider broker as the credential boundary.
  WHY: Operators are misled about the effective command-not-found and ambient-key behavior.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `emit_context` at 562-564 (`max_bytes <= 0` now returns a header plus `(targeted context disabled: ...)`) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: A zero byte budget now emits a non-empty disabled-context block.
  WHY: Callers expecting the previous empty-string sentinel receive unexpected prompt content.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_signal_child_group` at lines 404-434 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The privileged kill subprocess has no timeout and can fail without stopping the process group.
  WHY: A wedged sudo can block the guard event loop, while unavailable sudo or invalid PGID leaves the editor alive.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
